purpose: Golden outputs of the TypeScript reference implementation of subtrack, replayed by the Rust port.

env.home: per-case fake HOME under the case temp root
env.dbDir: per-case fake SUBSC_CLI_DB_DIR under the case temp root
env.runRoot: os.tmpdir() — path-safety bases (home+tmp) must include the case root

dateInjection.note: Seed dates and today-relative outputs were computed on capturedOnDate (UTC). The Rust test harness sets SUBTRACK_TODAY so its 'today' matches.

normalizations: {WORK}   — per-case temp root (db/, cwd/, home/ live beneath it)
{STAMP}  — YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS in generated filenames and file paths (backups)
Note: year-less short dates ("Nov 8") are stored literally — the Rust harness reproduces them via SUBTRACK_TODAY injection.
stepSeparator: <<<step N>>> (1-based) precedes each step's output in multi-step cases
fileOutputs: New/changed files in the case cwd are stored as <group>/<id>.files/<path> with mode bytes (text normalized, binary raw), gzip (stored raw; compare after gunzip), or skip (.sha256 sidecars, .xlsx, raw .db — random IVs / implementation-defined bytes).

excluded.reason: OS/desktop notification side effects (notify-send/osascript) — environment dependent
OS/desktop notification side effects (notify-send/osascript) — environment dependent
covered by the dedicated mcp probe case
shell pipeline, redirection, or substitution — not capturable as a single argv
